title: lonicera chrysantha var. koehneana
intro: Lonicera chrysantha var. koehneana, commonly known as Golden Honeysuckle or Yellow Honeysuckle, is a plant species that belongs to the family Caprifoliaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, fever, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Lonicera chrysantha var. koehneana include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant effects, which aid in reducing inflammation, lowering fever, and relieving cough and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
